insight: When drafting, prioritize three core components: stuns, damage, and objective-taking. Identify gaps in your team's lineup and pick heroes that fill the most critical deficiency.

insight: Ranged damage dealers want their support in lane frequently. Play aggressively together to protect each other with spells and attacks, especially against kill lanes.

insight: When your support is stack pulling, play defensively as a bodyguard for the pull camp rather than contesting enemy CS. This prevents unnecessary damage while maintaining your lane advantage.

insight: Use 'ever-expanding circles' map awareness: when enemies go missing, they can be anywhere within a radius determined by how long they've been off-map. Scan in suspected directions to verify gank threats.

insight: Use scan to check the direction enemies went when missing as a group. Assume 90% of the time aggressive enemy positioning is real, not a bluff, and TP away to safety.

insight: Adjust farming patterns based on enemy information: farm forwards when you have visibility on enemy positions, farm backwards when you lack information. This reduces gank deaths significantly.

insight: Prioritize 2-3 survivability items when ahead before building pure damage items. Buy Manta against heroes with heavy single-target damage and spells (Phoenix, Death Prophet, Shadow Shaman).

insight: Against Ursa that's behind, skip Hurricane Pike and go Butterfly for damage instead. Avoid Hurricane Pike against heroes that are hard to kite (those with pull or gap-close abilities).

insight: When strong with items, don't half-commit to fights. Get your full team together via smoke gank before engaging, rather than casually walking into tower and expecting to win.

insight: After kills, prioritize taking towers and natural objectives over forcing high ground. Check all lanes before committing to take another tier 2 to avoid losing map pressure.

insight: Avoid taking high ground without a clear advantage. Only commit to high ground when enemies are dead, lanes are pushed, and your team can walk in safely. Instead, kill enemies caught on the map.

insight: When ahead, communicate item timings to your team to prevent unnecessary fights. Say 'I'm farming X item, then we go' rather than appearing inactive while building survivability.

insight: Build survivability items first (BKB, Manta) to enable damage output, then add damage items (Daedalus). General rule: 2-3 survivability items when ahead, then damage-focused items.

insight: Boots of Travel 2 helps you connect with scattered teammates. Satanic provides sustain against multi-source burst damage like Ursa and Death Prophet ultimates.

insight: If enemy carry builds only pure damage items (Basher, MKB, Blink) without survivability, play around their damage and avoid them. They can't itemize to kill you effectively without defensive items.

insight: Monitor teammate positioning when ahead. If they're separated (support top, mid hero elsewhere), wait patiently for them to naturally group rather than forcing a disadvantageous fight.
